sloka: रावणम् सहिताः सर्वे राक्षसम् काम रूपिणम् ।सीतया सह वैदेह्या मार्गध्वम् इति चोदिताः ॥४-५२-८॥
transliteration: rāvaṇam sahitāḥ sarve rākṣasam kāma rūpiṇam ।sītayā saha vaidehyā mārgadhvam iti coditāḥ ॥4-52-8॥

translations.english: 'We along with the dreadful monkeys are sent with Angada as our chief to the southern direction, guarded by Yama and inhabited by sage Agasti. We are commanded to search Sita, princess of Videha and also the abode of the demon Ravana who assumes any form at his free will.
translations.hindi: तुम सब कपिश्रेष्ठ अपनी अपनी आँखें बंद कर लो--क्योकि विना वेत्र बंद किए इत भिल से कोई नहीं निकल सकता
